title: GoodRx
slugLine: A plan to grow GoodRx beyond prescription discounts with an in-house telehealth team and new revenue streams.

research.problem: A cost-sensitive consumer who saves on prescriptions through GoodRx needs ==a more sustainable and rewarding way== to get affordable medication, but **GoodRx relies mainly on prescription discounts** and leaves other revenue streams untapped.

stakeholders.name: Cost-sensitive consumers
stakeholders.note: Who save on prescriptions through GoodRx

painPoints.label: A narrow revenue base
painPoints.detail: GoodRx relies mainly on prescription discounts and misses chances for greater profitability.

painPoints.label: Savings left on the table
painPoints.detail: Consumers might miss out on savings or better healthcare benefits if GoodRx does not make the most of its opportunities.

painPoints.label: An extra visit to pay for
painPoints.detail: Getting a prescription still means a separate doctor’s visit and its copay.

insights.evidence: The global telehealth market was valued at about $83.5B in 2022 and is projected to grow at a 24% CAGR to $455.27B by 2030.

insights.insight: The US market alone will more than quadruple
insights.evidence: US telemedicine is projected to grow from $35.75B in 2024 to $160.45B by 2034, a 16.2% CAGR.

insights.insight: Competitors already pair care with prescriptions
insights.evidence: Hims & Hers, Ro and Teladoc Health offer online consultations with medication delivery. Ro partners with Eli Lilly, and Teladoc with pharmacies, to offer weight-loss drugs such as Zepbound.
Personalized drug recommendations based on medical history put the capital hidden in medical data to work.

roadmap.what: Recruit an in-house telehealth team: practitioners, telehealth specialists and tech support
Sign profit-sharing, commission and advertising partnerships with pharma companies, insurers and tech partners
Build virtual consultations and medication management into the GoodRx platform
Broader access to affordable care, especially in underserved and rural areas

design.lead: The plan keeps prescription discounts at the core and adds an in-house telehealth team, so users can get a prescription without paying for another doctor’s visit, while ads, subscriptions, profit sharing and commissions fund the savings.

blocks.title: Products and services
items: Telehealth prescriptions without an additional doctor’s-visit copay
Personalized drug recommendations based on medical history

rows.label: Advertising
cells: Targeted in-app ads and sponsored placements from pharma companies, providers, insurers and pharmacy partners

rows.label: Cross-subsidization
cells: GoodRx Gold subscriptions for deeper discounts help fund savings for users on the free service

rows.label: Profit sharing
cells: Pharmacies share revenue on every prescription filled through GoodRx; health systems and insurers share profits on referrals

rows.label: Commissions
cells: A fee on every prescription filled and every telehealth consultation booked, plus commissions for referrals to outside services

rows.label: Partnerships
cells: Income from collaborations with insurers, telehealth and wellness brands

blocks.title: Resources required
items: Talent: doctors, nurse practitioners, telehealth developers, marketing and partnership managers
Technology: telehealth software, data analytics tools and platform integration
Capital: investors or strategic partners to fund new services and hiring

results.lead: In ten years, the plan sees GoodRx as ==a one-stop shop for prescription savings and telehealth==, with better health outcomes and higher medication adherence.

rings.name: Global
rings.label: Global telehealth market, 2022
rings.note: Projected to grow at a 24% CAGR from 2023 to reach $455.27B by 2030.

rings.name: US
rings.label: US telemedicine market, 2024
rings.note: Projected to reach $160.45B by 2034, a 16.2% CAGR.

blocks.title: What success looks like
items: Sustainable revenue growth: several revenue streams, without compromising the mission
Telehealth adoption: an in-house team serving users across demographics
Market leadership: one platform for prescription savings, telehealth and diverse revenue
Customer satisfaction: customers value a one-stop shop for savings and telehealth

blocks.title: Impact models
items: Universal healthcare: measure the total savings delivered to patients against market prices for prescription drugs
Pro bono partnerships that deliver free or low-cost healthcare options
